then.description: Add the following to your Roguish Skills. See the Rogue Starting Move, **Tricks of the Trade**.

else.description: You don't have the **Tricks of the Trade** Rogue Starting Move, so you gain it, but only with these two Skills. If you already had any of these Roguish Skills, work with the GM to create a new one for each redundant Skill.

submoves.title: Tricks of the Trade
submoves.description: When you **Defy Danger** or **Sneak Past** by applying one of your Roguish Skills, you cheat; roll with 1d8+1d6 (instead of 2d6).

submoves.title: Sneak Attack
submoves.description: When you **Trade Blows**+Dex, if your opponent is distracted or flanked (and you're wearing light or no armor):

outcomes.text: You can choose to deal **max dmg** for free.

title: Always a Way Out
description: When **you're in too deep and look for a way out**, roll+dex.

outcomes.text: You and your allies are gone.
You need to leave something behind; the GM will say what.
It was a trick or a trap; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: Backstab
description: When you **ambush a surprised or defenseless opponent with a** **precise** **weapon**, you may roll **dmg** as normal, or may instead roll+dex.

bullets: Reduce their armor **dmg reduction** by 1 until they repair it
Disable a weapon or other form of attack until they recover it

outcomes.text: They were ready; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: Poisoncraft
description: You get **adv** to **Defy Danger** against poison. You also get a poisoner's kit. Mark to produce a poison on the spot; state its effect, then choose two from the following:

bullets: it can be delivered by touch (otherwise it's ingestion)
the GM doesn't add an *"and"* or *"but" to the effect (otherwise they do)
you clear a poisoner's kit use

title: Stalker in Shadows
description: Add *hide in shadows* to your Roguish Skills. If you already have it, instead work with the GM to create a new Roguish Skill.

outcomes.text: When you **Sneak Past** with a Roguish Skill, roll with 1d10+1d6 (instead of 1d8+1d6)
When you **look for a hiding space**, the GM will tell you where the best spot is, but it's up to you to get there.
